page.notes: The left edge of the scan is cut off and partly covered by a dark shadow, so the first letters of many lines are hidden; those are marked illegible. The law numbers 1., 16., 21. and 27. in the left margin are only partly visible and are uncertain. The final catchword "verba" is printed at the right below the last line. Two possible readings were not confirmed: "NEMO"/"VERM" at the start of the Ulpianus paragraph and "praefet" in the Javolenus paragraph.
